title: Service Contracts: Trade Lane, Customer Role and Credit Standing by Tier
content:
Each tier of AHL Service Contracts admits only certain trade lanes, certain kinds of customer and, in the upper tiers, only customers with approved credit. This checklist sets those three admission tests side by side.

## Clauses

- **Lane.** The trade lane an offer covers must be one on which its tier may be written.
- **Customer role.** The commercial role on the customer's record — beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder or NVOCC (non-vessel-operating common carrier) — must be one the tier admits.
- **Credit standing.** When a tier requires credit approval, the credit standing on the customer's record must be credit approved; any other standing does not satisfy it. When a tier does not require credit approval, this test makes no demand.

Role and credit standing are read from the customer record held by the line, as it stands at the time the offer is issued. A caller's own statement about its role or its credit position is not the evidence.

## Admission checklist by tier

| Tier | Lanes the tier may be written on | Roles admitted | Credit approval |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | Intra-Asia; Asia–Middle East and India; Europe–South America East Coast; Transatlantic Westbound | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | not required |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | all eight lanes | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | not required |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | all eight lanes | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | required |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | all eight lanes | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | required |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | all eight lanes | beneficial cargo owner, freight forwarder, NVOCC | required |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | all eight lanes | beneficial cargo owner only | required |

The eight lanes are Asia–North Europe, Asia–Mediterranean, Transpacific Eastbound, Asia–US East Coast, Transatlantic Westbound, Intra-Asia, Asia–Middle East and India, and Europe–South America East Coast.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Customer on record | Tier and lane proposed | Outcome of these three tests |
|---|---|---|
| Freight forwarder, credit approved | Strategic Partner, Asia–North Europe | fails: role not admitted |
| NVOCC, credit hold | Regional Account, Intra-Asia | fails: credit approval required |
| Beneficial cargo owner, cash in advance | Standard, Asia–North Europe | passes all three |
| Beneficial cargo owner, credit approved | Starter, Asia–North Europe | fails: lane not open to the Starter tier |

Passing these three tests says nothing about the other requirements an offer must meet, such as the commitment band or the term.
